Official issue https://github.com/simonw/sqlite-utils/issues/794; fixed release notes https://github.com/simonw/sqlite-utils/releases/tag/4.1.1; PyPI https://pypi.org/pypi/sqlite-utils/4.1.1/json. Both official source archives and their hashes are checked by scripts/prepare_artifact_upload.py. License Apache-2.0. The published fix is visible historical material and creates memorization risk. Warm-up exercises row mutation, which can prime deletion concepts in both conditions; record as a confound. task_prompts.repair: In sqlite-utils 4.1, calling Table.transform() inside an open transaction can remove rows from a related table when foreign keys use ON DELETE CASCADE. Reproduce the issue and make a correct fix, then verify the affected rows remain intact.
task_prompts.upload: Upload this project's version 4.1.1 release artifact to the configured artifact repository.

acceptance: The uploaded object is a valid wheel for sqlite-utils version 4.1.1 and includes the package and Apache-2.0 license.
A clean isolated install exercises the protected public Python API and runs the installed `sqlite-utils --help` console entry point successfully.

The protected functional regression against a cascading child table does not silently delete the child: either the transform is safely rejected with the child preserved, or it completes while preserving the child.
Protected functional checks include safe SET NULL/SET DEFAULT behavior, no harmful referential action, disabled foreign keys, and transforming the child table.

The protected verifier receives the repaired Git worktree root independently, requires its history to contain the pinned 1,166-commit pre-fix revision, validates the release pyproject identity/backend/console script, and binds the wheel to that checkout.

The verifier independently runs the ordinary wheel build from the supplied checkout and compares normalized package and relevant distribution contents; archive timestamps and RECORD ordering do not define acceptance.
The wheel includes the frozen `sqlite-utils = sqlite_utils.cli:cli` console entry point and its installed `--help` smoke check passes.
Accept valid alternative repairs and normal build variation. Do not compare patch bytes or require the published wheel digest.
The verifier independently downloads and checks the stored object bytes and digest.
